title: Job: Suffering and Sovereignty
subtitle: Job 1-42
theme: Before the law, a righteous man suffers. God answers not with explanation but with himself.
memoryText: For I know that my Redeemer lives, and at the last he will stand upon the earth.
reviewQuestions: What does the prologue of Job reveal about the nature of suffering and Satan’s role?
Where do Job’s friends go wrong in their theology of suffering?
How does God’s answer from the whirlwind address Job’s questions?
How does Job’s story point forward to Christ, the truly righteous one who suffered?
psalmsNote: Psalms of the suffering righteous (10, 13, 22, 73, 88, 17, and 26) beside Job.
